**PR 2 of #882 — Decisions view (R882-3)**

Built lib/decisions-model.mjs's buildDecisionsModel(adrsSection, driftSection): one row per adr-index.mjs's parsed ADR, through governance-model.mjs's row() helper (so source/sourceStamp are derived the same way every governance view derives them — the deviation PR 1 flagged for Roadmap does not repeat here, since ADR rows have a real per-row file path). An unreadable ADR is kept in place, sorted last (number: null). issues passes through exactly as parseAdr extracted it, labelled via the model's own ISSUES_LABEL constant ('issues referenced in this ADR', never 'driving issues' — the parser does not distinguish the two). driftWarnings is adrDrift's own result, passed through unchanged as a section-shaped value so a failed drift read degrades only the warnings, never the table. Wired into app.js's renderGovernance sub-router (governanceView === 'decisions') and views-owned.test.mjs (decisions identifiers flip from forbidden to present; anti-patterns/history/by-actor stay forbidden for PR 3-5). Full suite 5870 pass / 0 fail (baseline 5862 + 8 new: 7 in decisions-model.test.mjs, +1 net in views-owned.test.mjs). Counted diff 162/1000 (plan estimate ~230).
